QuestInfo.name: 10 Boogies's Request
QuestInfo.0: After the #o1140130# case closed, #p1103004# still seems to need you for something. You wonder what. Better go talk to #b#p1103004##k and find out.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103004# thanks you for helping her solve the mystery, but tells you she has a little predicament. She can't leave her post to submit her report! She wonders if you could deliver the report to her boss. Your new task is to deliver the #t4032320# to #b#p1101002##k in #b#m130000000##k.\n\nTake the ship headed to #b#m130000000# from the #bEreve Bound Platform#k north of #b#m104020000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the report to #p1101002# and received a reward. You noticed that he had a very peculiar way of speaking which, to you, seemed totally inappropriate yet absolutely proper in tone. It reminded you of someone...

0.0: Um... hi, Aran. I know that you're busy, but can you help me out once more? This time, it's not about the information #p1002104# has been looking for. It's a personal favor, and I will reward you separately for your work. What do you say?

yes.0: Thanks to your help, I was able to complete the investigation, and now it's time to turn in the reports...but I can't leave this place knowing that the puppeteer may show up anytime. Do you think you can go to #b#m130000000##k and submit this report to #p1101002# for me?
yes.1: Do you know how to get to #m130000000#? Head over to the #bStation to Ereve#k at the top of #b#m104020000##k, and there should be an #bAirship to #b#m130000000#. You'll get there in about 30 seconds. It's not too bad of a trip!

no.0: Oh, I guess you're too busy. What should I do? I wonder if there are any knights-in-training with some free time around.

1.0: What is it? Hmmm? Isn't that #t4032320#? How could she have a stranger send such an important report? What if confidential information is leaked? I will have to cut #p1103004#'s pay... Hahaha, just kidding. This report doesn't include anything that's classified.

yes.0: Anyway, thank you for your help. Just to let you know though, #m130000000# is not a place that really welcomes strangers. So unless you're interested in becoming a Knight, you should leave soon. The island is already overflowing with #bKnights who are training to stop the Black Mage#k.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #b#m130000000##k yet? Please go to #m130000000# and submit the report for me. Otherwise, #b#p1101002##k will throw a fit, and I don't like being grilled by #p1101002#...

item.0: Welcome to #m130000000#, that is, if you've come to become a knight. If you're not here to become a knight, you are not welcome, so please move aside.
